careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Polyester Satin
Polyester satin is often used on baseball and retro varsity jackets. It has a slick face that can snag. Turn the jacket inside out and place it in a mesh bag. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Hang or lay flat to dry so the fabric keeps its smooth look and drape.

Do: Steam from the inside if the jacket wrinkles.
Do: Store on padded hangers to avoid hanger dents.
Do not: Use a hot iron directly on the satin face.
Do not: Wash with items that have open zips or hooks.
